claims: JAŸ-Z and The Roots are set to headline the 2026 Roots Picnic.
The 2026 Roots Picnic is on May 30-31, 2026.
The 2026 Roots Picnic is held at Belmont Plateau, Philadelphia, PA.
The headlining performance on Saturday, May 30 will feature JAŸ-Z celebrating the 30th anniversary of his debut album Reasonable Doubt with The Roots.
JAŸ-Z and The Roots' headlining performance marks their first joint performance in over a decade.
Presale for Roots Picnic 2026 tickets began March 17, 2026.
General on-sale for Roots Picnic 2026 tickets starts March 18, 2026, at 10 AM ET
